primitives.name: Grid Overflow Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: --description: Responsive / breakpoint audit of the cockpit allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash(git diff*), Bash(git log*), Bash(git status*) --Audit the cockpit grid and cards across breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Component_Width': 'Dimensionless column count or absolute pixel width', 'Container_Width': 'Absolute pixel width of grid container'}
primitives.assumptions: (1) Grid system uses fixed or fractional column widths; (2) Container dimensions are static or bounded by viewport constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Overflow occurs when the ratio exceeds unity, causing clipping or horizontal scrollbars.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal prediction intervals for adversarial betting margins, where \text{Overflow} corresponds to interval boundary violations.
layer2.telemetry: Pixel-based scroll detection or DOM bounding box analysis.

primitives.name: Touch Target Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: Find: overflow, cramped multi-column lists that should stack, fixed widths, text that wraps badly, and touch targets under ~44px.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_touch': "Area of interactive element's hitbox in square pixels", 'w': 'Width of hitbox in pixels', 'h': 'Height of hitbox in pixels'}
primitives.assumptions: (1) Interactive elements include buttons, links, and form controls; (2) The threshold of 44px² accounts for finger precision and ergonomic standards.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Compliance failure happens when the product falls below the threshold, leading to usability errors.

layer2.mapping: Dual to GSE's collision avoidance safety margins, where insufficient area represents a high-risk state.
layer2.telemetry: Heatmap analysis of user tap failures or direct measurement of element bounding rectangles.

primitives.name: Multi-Column List Reorganization
primitives.verbatim_quote: --Audit the cockpit grid and cards across breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop). Find: overflow, cramped multi-column lists
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'N_columns': 'Number of columns at breakpoint b', 'W(b)': 'Viewport width at breakpoint b', 'W_threshold': 'Width at which multi-column display becomes feasible', 'C': 'Constant number of columns for wide screens'}
primitives.assumptions: (1) The system maintains a constant column count C for large displays; (2) Below a critical width W_threshold, the list must stack into a single column.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The regime W(b) < W_threshold triggers a structural transition from grid to linear layout.

layer2.mapping: Reduces to GSI's Bayesian changepoint detection for switching between UI rendering strategies based on available screen space.
layer2.telemetry: Viewport width measurements paired with visual inspection of column numbers.
